fields.Front: When and in what format are the CS3357A midterm and final exam?
fields.Back:
Midterm: Monday October 19, 2026, in class (MC-110, 12:30-2:30), 1 h 40 min, closed book, multiple choice, no make-up (weight shifts to the final only with approved academic consideration); covers material taught before it.
Final: scheduled by the University in Dec 11-22, cumulative, closed book, 3 hours, multiple choice.

fields.Front: Per the REVISED Fall 2026 schedule, when are the quizzes and the assignment release/due dates?
fields.Back:
Sept 14 and 17 lectures were cancelled, shifting everything one teaching week (skipping Reading Week Oct 10-18).
Quiz 1: Thu Oct 1 (was Sept 24). Quiz 2: Thu Oct 29 (was Oct 22).
A1: released Oct 1, due Oct 23. A2: released Oct 23, due Nov 6. A3: released Nov 6, due Nov 27. Midterm unchanged: Mon Oct 19.
Revised topic order: Wk3 fundamentals/Application layer, Wk4-5 Application layer and network programming, Wk7 midterm then Transport, Wk8-10 Network layer and routing, Wk11-12 Link layer, Wk13 Physical layer, Wk14 wrap-up.

fields.Front: Summarize the CS3357A policies on attendance, late assignments, and generative AI.
fields.Back:
Attendance: iClicker, pass/fail per lecture; the first two weeks do not count; up to five further lectures may be missed; no answering for others.
Assignments: individual socket-programming/protocol work via Gradescope; 4 late coupons per term (each = 24 h), max 3 per assignment; nothing accepted after the late window; similarity checks.
AI: not permitted for producing code or final solutions; limited use for background learning only.

fields.Text: CS3357A grading: iClicker participation {{c1::8%}}; two quizzes {{c1::10% (5 + 5)}}; three assignments {{c1::37% (10 + 12 + 15)}}; midterm {{c1::15%}}; final {{c1::30%}}. Combined midterm + final must be at least {{c1::40%}} or the mark is capped at 45%.
